from pathlib import Path
import base64,gzip,hashlib,importlib.util,io,json,re,shutil,sys,tarfile
import pandas as pd
from pytest import MonkeyPatch
root=Path(".").resolve();source=root/"after";sys.path.insert(0,str(source))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("demand_fixture",source/"tests/test_gov_exposure.py")
fx=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(fx)
from scripts import build_demand as bd
from collectors import edgar_facts as ef
from engine import demand_alerts
from lib import config,pages,site_assets
assert bd.write_page is pages.write_page
browser=root/"browser-v2";browser.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
scenarios={"fixture":{"MSFT":{("capex",2025):None},"GOOGL":{("cash",2025):None},"AMZN":{("capex",fy):10e9 for fy in range(2020,2026)},"ORCL":{("capex",2024):None}},"current":None}
receipts={}
for label,edits in scenarios.items():
    target=browser/label;target.mkdir()
    shutil.copytree((root/"fixtures-v2-after/complete/fixture/data") if edits is not None else source/"data",target/"data")
    for relative in ["config.yml","templates/demand.html.j2","templates/_seo_head.html.j2","templates/_site_nav.html.j2","templates/_navlinks.html.j2","templates/data_base.js"]:
        p=target/relative;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(source/relative,p)
    with MonkeyPatch.context() as mp:
        if edits is not None:
            facts={1000+i:fx._companyfacts(edits.get(ticker,{})) for i,ticker in enumerate(fx._SPENDERS)}
            requests=[];wires=[]
            def get_json(url):
                cik=int(re.search(r"CIK(\d+)\.json$",url).group(1));assert cik in facts;requests.append(cik);return facts[cik]
            mp.setattr(ef,"_get_json",get_json)
            mp.setattr(ef.time,"sleep",lambda seconds:None)
            mp.setattr(ef,"_dm_wire_cache",lambda cik,data:wires.append((cik,data is facts[cik])))
            rows=[]
            for i,ticker in enumerate(fx._SPENDERS):
                rows.extend({**r,"ticker":ticker} for r in ef._statements_for(1000+i))
            assert requests==list(facts) and wires==[(cik,True) for cik in facts]
            pd.DataFrame(rows).to_parquet(target/"data/edgar/statements.parquet")
        mp.setattr(config,"ROOT",target);mp.setattr(config,"data_dir",lambda:target/"data")
        mp.setattr(demand_alerts,"rebuild",lambda data,**kw:[])
        if hasattr(pages,"_shim_checked"):mp.setattr(pages,"_shim_checked",False)
        raw=bd.build(root=target)
        site=target/config.load()["storage"]["site_dir"]
        final=(site/"demand.html").read_text()
        assert raw!=final and "data-dbase" in final and "shared_shell_bridge.js" in final
        for asset in ["theme.js","theme.css","navigation-refresh.css","product-nav-icons.css","logo_config.js","stock-logos.js","live.js","account.js","nav_market.js"]:
            site_assets.copy_asset(asset,source/"templates"/asset,site)
        shutil.copyfile(source/"site/live_config.js",site/"live_config.js")
        shutil.copytree(source/"templates/fonts",site/"fonts")
        _,_,burdens=bd._collect(target)
        receipts[label]={"html_sha256":hashlib.sha256((site/"demand.html").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"html_bytes":(site/"demand.html").stat().st_size,"payer_rows":{chain+"|"+ticker:{"burden":b,"texts":fx._burden_cells(final,ticker)[1]} for chain,items in burdens.items() for ticker,b in items.items() if b is not None},"assets":[{"path":str(p.relative_to(site)),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"bytes":p.stat().st_size} for p in sorted(site.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()]}
bundle=root/"browser-pages.tar.gz"
with tarfile.open(bundle,"w:gz") as archive:
    for label in scenarios:archive.add(browser/label/"site",arcname=label)
encoded=base64.b64encode(bundle.read_bytes()).decode()
(root/"browser-pages.b64").write_text("\n".join(encoded[i:i+76] for i in range(0,len(encoded),76))+"\n")
(root/"browser-emission.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipts,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"pages":{k:{"html_sha256":v["html_sha256"],"html_bytes":v["html_bytes"],"payers":len(v["payer_rows"]),"assets":len(v["assets"])} for k,v in receipts.items()},"bundle_bytes":bundle.stat().st_size,"bundle_sha256":hashlib.sha256(bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"b64_lines":(len(encoded)+75)//76}),flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
root=Path(".")
expected=json.loads("[{\"path\":\"engine/gov_exposure.py\",\"sha\":\"75f22bee1db9f62b41c21a8ace6e123403f7fdd0\",\"sha256\":\"8dde8530585640d18ae0acbed7d0eb7b6447e7ecee369c4799c4854cd11a2734\",\"bytes\":13303},{\"path\":\"templates/demand.html.j2\",\"sha\":\"d35b68cc809dff66d30f072a3644d60666a3c362\",\"sha256\":\"a846616df34678cd0b68f54f4f998acc5721e93e242ffc5a355700fbd9ed2a87\",\"bytes\":16027},{\"path\":\"tests/test_gov_exposure.py\",\"sha\":\"abc3a9d51fde4a55e1a3c0326cd7cb9986476ef0\",\"sha256\":\"9a9987b35f1fdd36b99f5d17636cf716f7afff65813a94bb8b82f0106b90d4af\",\"bytes\":25768}]")
for item in expected:
    p=root/"after"/item["path"]; b=p.read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()==item["sha"],item["path"]
    assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==item["sha256"],item["path"]
print("CANDIDATE_HASHES_VERIFIED",flush=True)
py="/opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.14/bin/python3.14"
env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
cmd=[py,"-m","pytest","tests/test_gov_exposure.py","tests/test_build_demand.py","-q","-p","no:cacheprovider"]
results={}
original=(root/"before/tests/test_gov_exposure.py").read_bytes()
try:
    (root/"before/tests/test_gov_exposure.py").write_bytes((root/"after/tests/test_gov_exposure.py").read_bytes())
    for label in ["before","after"]:
        start=time.monotonic()
        p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root/label,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=180)
        log=root/(label+"-tests.log");log.write_bytes(p.stdout)
        lines=p.stdout.decode(errors="replace").splitlines()
        results[label]={"returncode":p.returncode,"seconds":round(time.monotonic()-start,3),"log_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(),"log_bytes":len(p.stdout),"tail":lines[-14:]}
        print(label.upper(),json.dumps(results[label]),flush=True)
finally:
    (root/"before/tests/test_gov_exposure.py").write_bytes(original)
(root/"test-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+"\n")
print("DEMAND_NATIVE_TESTS_COMPLETE",flush=True)
